battery_chamber_cover_latch.name: Battery-chamber cover latch
battery_chamber_cover_latch.default_function: Slide the battery-chamber cover latch as shown and open the battery-chamber cover.

battery_latch.name: Battery latch
battery_latch.default_function: To remove the battery, press the battery latch to the side, and slide the battery out of the camera as shown.

bluetooth_button.name: Bluetooth button
bluetooth_button.default_function: Press and hold to display the Bluetooth setting menu.

control_lever.name: Control lever
control_lever.default_function: Pull toward the grip: SURROUND VIEW; pull and hold toward the grip: ASPECT RATIO; pull toward the lens: DIGITAL TELE-CONV.; pull and hold toward the lens: FS RECIPE.

disp_back_button.name: DISP (display)/BACK button
disp_back_button.default_function: Controls the viewfinder and LCD indicators; backs out of menus.

drive_delete_button.name: DRIVE/DELETE button
drive_delete_button.default_function: Displays the drive-mode menu during shooting; deletes pictures during playback.

exposure_compensation_dial.name: Exposure compensation dial
exposure_compensation_dial.default_function: Chooses an exposure compensation amount; at C, exposure compensation is adjusted with the front command dial.

film_simulation_dial.name: Film simulation dial
film_simulation_dial.default_function: Selects the film simulation or custom setting associated with the dial position.

focus_mode_selector.name: Focus mode selector
focus_mode_selector.default_function: Selects single AF, continuous AF, or manual focus.

focus_stick.name: Focus stick (focus lever)
focus_stick.default_function: Tilts or presses to select the focus area and can navigate menus.

front_command_dial.name: Front command dial
front_command_dial.default_function: Rotates to adjust its assigned shooting setting; pressing the center selects or cycles the assigned front command dial role.

lcd_touchscreen.name: Touch screen
lcd_touchscreen.default_function: Provides touch controls for shooting, focus, menus, and playback when enabled.

lens_release_button.name: Lens release button
lens_release_button.default_function: Releases the attached lens for removal.

power_switch.name: ON/OFF switch
power_switch.default_function: Turns the camera on and off.

rear_command_dial.name: Rear command dial
rear_command_dial.default_function: Rotates to adjust settings; center press is assigned FOCUS CHECK by default.

shutter_button.name: Shutter button
shutter_button.default_function: Half-press focuses and locks exposure when enabled; full-press takes a picture.

ladders.basis: The firmware caches ADC channel 1 at 0x225c918 + 2 * channel (observed in an emulator run with a distinct sample on every channel) and reads it as a 12-bit value. No released level is established here: it is the run's ADC sample for this channel.

rungs.basis: Band 2618..3066, halfwords of the factory configuration page read through the stock tag reader 0x15b5a64 (tags 0x3853 low, 0x3851 high); callback 0x1523e60 accepts this band for the DRIVE key alone; the other bands it accepts are shared with a neighboring key, so they are combined presses. The sample is the band midpoint.

Band 2102..2325, halfwords of the factory configuration page read through the stock tag reader 0x15b5a64 (tags 0x384b low, 0x3849 high); callback 0x1523e60 accepts this band for the K_Q key alone; the other bands it accepts are shared with a neighboring key, so they are combined presses. The sample is the band midpoint.
